description: Creates an alert on the linked SupaPark account for a ride at Walt Disney World, or at Disneyland Resort when Disneyland watches are open (pass resort "dlr" or a Disneyland park; a Disneyland-only ride name also resolves there; dates are Pacific; a Disneyland ride never resolves to a Walt Disney World ride). kind "lightning_lane": alert when Lightning Lane return times open up (optionally for a specific date, and optionally only when the return time falls inside return_window). kind "wait_drop": alert when the standby wait drops to threshold_minutes or less. Delivery channel follows the account's plan. Requires a linked SupaPark account (pairing key).

client_label.description: Optional: who this watch is for, e.g. a travel advisor's client name or booking reference (40 characters max). Shown on the watch in SupaPark and returned by list_my_watches.

date.description: lightning_lane only: YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the next opening.

park.description: Optional park slug; a Disneyland Resort park (disneyland, california-adventure) selects Disneyland.

resort.description: Resort: "wdw" (Walt Disney World, the default) or "dlr" (Disneyland Resort; only while Disneyland watches are open). Slugs repeat across resorts (Space Mountain is at both): pass resort or park for a Disneyland ride.

return_window.description: lightning_lane only, optional: alert only when the return time is inside this window, 24-hour park-local times, e.g. {"start":"14:00","end":"16:00"}.

name: watch_ride
title: Watch a ride
